hackathons.name: HackVerse Pakistan #001
hackathons.theme: Build practical products that solve real Pakistan-first challenges.

001.overview: HackVerse Pakistan #001 is the first community-driven hackathon by HackVerse Pakistan. It is designed for students and early-career builders to ship real projects, collaborate in teams, and present solutions that can make measurable impact.
timeline: Opening ceremony and challenge briefing: 19 Sep 2026
rules: Participants must register before the deadline using the official registration form.
Teams can have 2 to 4 members. Solo registration may be matched into teams where possible.
Projects must be built during the event window. Existing code or templates are allowed only as support, not as the core project.
All submissions must include a project description, team members, and a demo link or recorded walkthrough.
Plagiarism, copied submissions, or harmful content lead to disqualification.
eligibility: Open to Pakistani students and early-career developers/designers/builders.
Teams can be from the same or different institutions.
Participants must follow the HackVerse code of conduct.
Internet access and required software setup are participant responsibilities.

faq.question: How do I register?
faq.answer: Use the official registration link on this website. After registering, join the HackVerse community channel for updates.

faq.question: Can beginners participate?
faq.answer: Yes. Beginners are encouraged to join, and mentors will support teams throughout the event.

faq.question: Is the event online or in-person?
faq.answer: Phase 1 is online-first with optional community hubs depending on partner availability.

faq.question: What must be included in the submission?
faq.answer: A project description, team details, tech stack, and a working demo link or video walkthrough.
